spec.description:
Bradford SoundScreen Acoustic is a high-density, non-combustible
glasswool acoustic and thermal insulation batt developed by CSR Bradford.
Engineered for internal walls, home theatres, master bedroom ensuites,
laundries, and mid-floors, it dramatically reduces sound transmission between
rooms by absorbing airborne acoustic energy. Made with FBS-1 bio-soluble
glasswool, it achieves an NRC rating up to 1.15, AS 1530.1 non-combustibility,
and provides dual acoustic-thermal benefits backed by a 70-year warranty.
features:
High-density glasswool delivers superior acoustic dampening
across speech frequencies

Cuts sound transmission through internal walls and
mid-floors by up to 75%

Early
Fire Hazard properties (0/0/0/0-1) to AS/NZS 1530.3

Dual acoustic and thermal
performance (R1.7 to R3.1)

Approved by National Asthma Council Australia's
Sensitive Choice program

FBS-1 bio-soluble glasswool formulation assessed as
non-hazardous
Will not pack down, shrink, rot, or deteriorate over time
Manufactured in Australia from up to 65% recycled glass

install: Verify framing cavity depth and stud spacing
Friction-fit SoundScreen batts into stud cavities or between mid-floor joists

Ensure full contact with framing on all sides without gaps, gaps cause sound
leakage

Trim neatly around electrical boxes, wiring, and pipes using an
insulation knife

Ensure wall and ceiling joints are completely sealed with
acoustic sealant

Hang internal wall plasterboard (or acoustic plasterboard)
and fasten per manufacturer instructions
selection_checklist:
Confirm
stud spacing (430mm for 450mm centres, 580mm for 600mm centres)

Confirm stud
depth (70mm for R2.0, 90mm for R2.5)

Determine acoustic isolation requirement
(e.g. bathroom, bedroom, media room)
Specify acoustic sealant and tape for all flanking gaps
limitations:
Do
not compress into stud cavities smaller than batt thickness

Acoustic
performance is significantly degraded if flanking paths and gaps are left
unsealed

Not for use in exposed exterior or wet environments without
protective lining

problem_keywords: toilet flushing noise in adjoining rooms
use_cases:
Acoustic lining in timber and steel stud walls dividing
bedrooms, bathrooms, and living areas

Between-floor cavity acoustic
soundproofing in double-storey homes

External wall acoustic upgrade to
insulate against noisy street traffic and barking dogs
not_for: Underfloor insulation directly exposed to weather or ground soil

Flooring
underlay under tiles or floorboards

Exposed wall lining without protective
drywall
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford SoundScreen Acoustic - Bradford is an
Australian-made, high-density glasswool batt engineered to reduce airborne and
impact noise transmission across internal walls, mid-floors, and external walls.
Providing sound reduction of up to 75% and acoustic absorption with an NRC up
to 1.15, it doubles as an effective thermal insulator with ratings from R1.7 to
R3.1. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and approved by Sensitive Choice,
it offers peace, quiet, and fire safety backed by a 70-year warranty.
